evals.prompt: Add Lingui i18n to this Vite React app with locales en, es, fr. I want automatic locale detection (URL param, saved user preference, browser language) and a language switcher component — no locale-prefixed URLs. Don't run npm install or builds — make the code and config changes only, and explain the choices that aren't obvious.
evals.expected_output: A working Lingui 6 setup that routes around @vitejs/plugin-react v6's removed babel option (switching to plugin-react-swc + pinned @lingui/swc-plugin, or explicitly pinning plugin-react to ^5), adds the @lingui/vite-plugin for direct .po imports, builds the fromUrl → fromStorage → fromNavigator detection chain with regional fallback, and persists the user's choice to both the URL param and storage.
expectations: The macro transform is NOT wired through the babel option of @vitejs/plugin-react v6 — the setup either switches to @vitejs/plugin-react-swc with @lingui/swc-plugin or explicitly downgrades/pins @vitejs/plugin-react to ^5, and the answer explains that v6 removed the babel option (silently ignoring it)

If @lingui/swc-plugin is used, its package.json entry is an exact version (no ^ or ~) or the answer explicitly calls for pinning it against the SWC runtime, and the config entry is a tuple or the linguiMacroSwcPlugin() helper — never a bare string
All added @lingui/* packages are major version 6 (or the answer states the Node ≥ 22.19 gate and deliberately pins ^5) — not unversioned installs described as v5
@lingui/vite-plugin is added and catalogs are imported as .po directly — no lingui compile step is scripted and no compiled-catalog gitignore rules are added
The detection chain reads the URL param first, then storage, then navigator, and unsupported values fall back through resolveLocale-style regional matching (es-MX → es) to the source locale

Saving the user's locale choice writes both the URL query param (via history.replaceState) and localStorage, with the shared-link rationale stated; localStorage access is guarded against sandboxed-iframe SecurityError
The existing dev/build scripts in package.json are kept — extended at most, never replaced
The hardcoded dir="ltr" on index.html's <html> element is removed or justified, since the runtime sets direction per locale

evals.prompt: Add Lingui i18n to this Next.js 15 App Router app with locales en and fr, using locale-prefixed URLs (unprefixed paths should keep serving English without changing the visible URL). There's existing middleware doing an auth check — keep it working. Don't run npm install or builds — make the code and config changes only, and explain the choices that aren't obvious.
evals.expected_output: A Lingui 6 App Router setup: swcPlugins tuple in next.config with an exactly-pinned @lingui/swc-plugin, lingui compile prepended to the existing scripts (Turbopack stays), per-locale i18n instances with setI18n for server components, a [locale] route segment with generateStaticParams and Promise params, and the locale rewrite merged into the existing auth middleware.
expectations: next.config gains experimental.swcPlugins with a [name, options] tuple entry for @lingui/swc-plugin — not a bare string
@lingui/swc-plugin is added as an exact version (no ^ or ~) or the answer explicitly instructs pinning it against the project's Next.js version via the compatibility table

No @lingui/loader and no custom webpack rule is added, and the --turbopack flag in the dev script is not removed; catalog compilation happens via lingui compile prepended to the existing dev/build script values (which are otherwise preserved)
The locale-routing logic is merged into the existing src/middleware.ts, preserving the /dashboard auth-redirect behavior — no second middleware or proxy file is created alongside it
Bare paths are handled with NextResponse.rewrite to the source locale (URL stays unchanged), not a redirect, matching the requested unprefixed-English behavior

Server components get their i18n instance via setI18n from @lingui/react/server backed by per-locale instances — the global i18n singleton from @lingui/core is not activated per-request on the server, and the answer states the concurrent-request locale-bleed rationale
The [locale] layout validates the param against the locale list and declares generateStaticParams, and params is awaited as a Promise (Next 15)
Any generateMetadata translation uses an explicitly passed instance (t(i18n) or i18n._) rather than a hook
Text direction and any locale metadata come from a single shared module rather than inline conditionals like locale === 'ar' ? 'rtl' : 'ltr'
